name: grasping-2026
description: Planar whole-arm grasping benchmark: VLM, Heuristic, PPO, and Diffusion Policy

scripts.collect:demos: docker compose run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace --entrypoint python demo scripts/collect_demos.py --demonstrator cage --seeds 2,6 --n-objects 4 --keep fc --out data/demos_cage_planar
scripts.train:diffusion: docker compose run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace --entrypoint python demo scripts/train_diffusion.py --demos data/demos_cage_planar --epochs 180 --min-steps-per-epoch 60 --lr 5e-4 --out models/diffusion_v2
scripts.demo:vlm: docker compose run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace --entrypoint python demo scripts/demo_vlm_grasp.py --planner vlm --seed 2
scripts.demo:heuristic: docker compose run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace --entrypoint python demo scripts/demo_vlm_grasp.py --planner heuristic --seed 2
